nodes.name: Manual isolated test
nodes.notes: Starts a whole-workflow test manually. Use only while all factory schedules are paused and executions have drained; manual runs are outside production serialization.

nodes.name: Poll inactive
nodes.notes: Scheduled entry, every 60 seconds after owner activation. The exported workflow is inactive, so importing it does not start polling.

nodes.name: Read control
nodes.notes: Reads up to two rows from the mapped control table. The next node requires exactly one valid global row; reading two exposes accidental duplicates.

nodes.name: Validate entry
nodes.notes: Checks the control row structure and chooses held or acquire. Missing, duplicate or malformed rows stop the workflow before remote work.

nodes.name: Already held
nodes.notes: True: preserve the existing hold and exit. False: attempt acquisition.

nodes.name: Report existing hold

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'skipped_held', control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Reports skipped_held with the existing execution/issue context. Does not update the row, call GitHub/Gemini or release another execution's hold.

nodes.name: Prepare acquisition
nodes.notes: Builds this execution's guard context: execution ID, start time and no selected issue yet. No table or remote write occurs here.

nodes.name: Acquire control
nodes.notes: Updates the idle global row to busy=true with this execution's context. An unsuccessful or uncertain update must not authorize remote work.

nodes.name: Check acquire receipt
nodes.notes: Checks that the update returned exactly the expected busy row and execution context. Stops if acquisition was not acknowledged.

nodes.name: Read acquired control
nodes.notes: Reads the control table again after acquisition. This independently checks persisted state rather than trusting only the update response.

nodes.name: Verify acquisition
nodes.notes: Requires the persisted singleton row to match this execution's acquisition. Only a confirmed hold reaches task discovery; failure leaves recovery to the owner.

nodes.name: Require acknowledged completion
nodes.notes: Accepts only one acknowledged success/no-work result. Unexpected failures never enter normal release; missing acknowledgement stops here with the guard held.

nodes.name: Read before release
nodes.notes: Reads the singleton control table before release to verify this execution still owns the hold.

nodes.name: Verify release ownership
nodes.notes: Requires the row, busy flag, execution ID, start time and expected issue context to match this run. Refuses to release a changed or foreign hold.

nodes.name: Release control
nodes.notes: Clears busy only after acknowledged success/no-work and ownership checks.

nodes.name: Check release receipt
nodes.notes: Requires the update response to show this execution's row with busy=false and unchanged context. An uncertain receipt cannot be reported as idle; inspect the actual row before recovery.

nodes.name: Read released control
nodes.notes: Reads the table after release to independently confirm persisted idle state. No new remote task work follows.

nodes.name: Confirm idle
nodes.notes: Requires one persisted idle row with the expected execution/start/issue context. Failure does not claim completion or assume a safe reset.

nodes.name: Report completion

parameters.jsCode:
const work=$('Require acknowledged completion').first().json;
return [{json:{status:'released',outcome:work.outcome,question_decision:work.question_decision??null,message:work.message??null,authorization_id:work.authorization_id??null,...(work.outcome==='success'?{issue_number:work.issue_number,source_key:work.source_key,refinement_comment_id:work.refinement_comment_id,budget:work.budget,generation:work.generation}:{}),control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Reports released only after receipt and persisted idle checks. Includes final guard context, source/comment references, token budget and generation attempt/status/delay history for new output; reuse has no new provider calls.

nodes.name: Discover issues
nodes.notes: Reads all pages of open repository issues. No GitHub write occurs. A pagination cap, API error or incomplete list is rejected downstream rather than treated as an empty queue.

nodes.name: Discover candidates
nodes.notes: Select open owner-authored Ideas/Ready/Waiting tasks by issue number. Conflicting labels or stranded Refining stop; question replies cannot enter ordinary refinement as factory output.

nodes.name: Have candidates
nodes.notes: True: inspect candidates in sequence. False: report acknowledged no-work so the acquired guard can be released.

nodes.name: Each candidate
nodes.notes: Loop output: inspect one issue. Done output: release as no-work. An unchanged candidate loops back here; successful refinement exits after one task per execution.

nodes.name: Read stage events
nodes.notes: Builds the URL from the incoming candidate issue number, without looking back through the loop output. Reads all event pages; the latest Ideas/Ready label event identifies when the current discussion stage began.

nodes.name: Read source comments
nodes.notes: Reads all comment pages for the latest candidate on the loop output. Uses the default latest run; explicit negative run indices fail in the deployed VM expression evaluator. Discussion and marked output identify revisions and repeats.

nodes.name: Plan revision
nodes.notes: Dispatch Waiting to the exact question policy. For Ideas/Ready, validate prior refinement/captured source and compute the canonical revision; include applicable changed-scope owner replies for renewed refinement.

nodes.name: New revision
nodes.notes: True: prepare this revision. False: inspect the next candidate.

nodes.name: No work
nodes.notes: Acknowledges an ordinary no-work poll and follows the guard release path.

nodes.name: Set issue context
nodes.notes: Writes the selected issue number into this execution's busy control row for diagnosis. This is still the same shared guard, not a separate reservation or task ledger.

nodes.name: Check issue context
nodes.notes: Requires an acknowledged context update matching this execution, start time and selected issue. Stops before GitHub mutations if the guard context is uncertain.

nodes.name: Reread source issue
nodes.notes: Fetches current issue content, author, open/closed state and labels immediately before the first transition.

nodes.name: Reread stage events
nodes.notes: Fetches current issue events again to detect a changed source-stage label event since planning.

nodes.name: Reread source comments
nodes.notes: Fetches current discussion again so new comments, edits/deletions and changed refinement history can be detected before mutation.

nodes.name: Validate before Refining
nodes.notes: Compares current issue, discussion, stage event and refinement history with the planned snapshot. Any mismatch stops with busy held rather than processing stale input.

nodes.name: Add Refining
nodes.notes: GitHub write: adds Refining while preserving existing labels. The source label remains temporarily; if interrupted here, the owner must reconcile the two-state issue.

nodes.name: Check added Refining
nodes.notes: Requires a successful label-add response containing both the expected old state and Refining, with no other managed state. An uncertain or unexpected response stops.

nodes.name: Remove Refining source
nodes.notes: GitHub write: removes only the previous Ideas/Ready label after Refining was acknowledged. Unrelated labels are preserved.

nodes.name: Check removed Refining
nodes.notes: Requires the removal response to confirm Refining as the only managed state. Failure retains the guard for owner inspection.

nodes.name: Read Refining issue
nodes.notes: Fetches the issue after the label transition. The next validation requires it to remain open, owner-authored and solely Refining.

nodes.name: Read Refining comments
nodes.notes: Fetches discussion after entering Refining to detect changed captured source or new owner input before inference/reuse.

nodes.name: Prepare Gemini
nodes.notes: Revalidates source and builds the unchanged prompt v3/template v1/schema request. Enforces a separate 32 KiB transport cap without truncation; actual token counting gates inference. An exact existing revision skips both provider calls.

nodes.name: Reuse marked output
nodes.notes: True: verify existing output. False: count tokens before inference.

nodes.name: Gemini countTokens
nodes.notes: Sends the complete prepared generateContentRequest to the same model's countTokens endpoint using the saved Gemini header credential. Counts input without generating a refinement. Errors/timeouts hold the guard; no retry or fallback.

nodes.name: Check token budget
nodes.notes: Requires a positive integer provider count. Reserves fixed schema allowance, 768 output tokens and 256 overhead within 4096 total. Oversize/invalid counts stop before inference. Passes the identical counted payload to generation and retains budget/digest evidence.

nodes.name: Initialize generation attempts
nodes.notes: Creates attempt 1 with empty history after counting. No persistent retry ledger or external work occurs here. The counter and original payload stay inside this execution.

nodes.name: Generation state
nodes.notes: Validates attempt 1–3, prior explicit-503 history, permitted 0/10/30s delay and unchanged counted payload/budget. Both initial and post-backoff paths enter here; invalid state stops without release.

nodes.name: Read generation guard
nodes.notes: Rereads the singleton control table before every generation attempt, including retries. This node must map to the same control table as all other guard nodes.

nodes.name: Verify generation guard
nodes.notes: Requires busy and this execution's row/start/selected-issue context. Stops if ownership changed while waiting; never releases a changed or foreign hold.

nodes.name: Read before generation
nodes.notes: Fetches current issue content/status/labels before each model attempt. Together with the next comment read, detects owner changes during backoff.

nodes.name: Comments before generation
nodes.notes: Runs once per activation despite upstream page items, then reads all current discussion before each model attempt, so captured edits/deletions, new owner instructions and changed refinement history stop a retry.

nodes.name: Prepare generation attempt
nodes.notes: Requires the original source, intact revision history and an open owner-authored Refining issue. Revalidates the exact counted request before sending it; changed source during backoff stops before another model call.

nodes.name: Gemini generateContent
nodes.notes: One HTTP attempt; selective 503 retry is controlled by the following nodes.

nodes.name: Evaluate generation attempt
nodes.notes: Records status/attempt/delay. Only explicit HTTP 503 with UNAVAILABLE can retry, at most twice. Honors Retry-After within the bounded delay or stops for manual recovery. HTTP 200 goes to schema validation; other errors or exhaustion hold the guard.

nodes.name: Retry unavailable
nodes.notes: True: take the bounded backoff. False: validate successful output.

nodes.name: Retry backoff
nodes.notes: Waits 10s then 30s only, within the live execution; busy stays held. No resume webhook, durable offload or automatic restart recovery. After waiting, guard/source checks run again. An interruption keeps the hold for manual recovery.

nodes.name: Validate and render
nodes.notes: Requires one STOP candidate, valid final JSON/schema, acceptable size, actual token counts and model version. Excludes thought content and escapes model text into fixed Markdown with workflow-generated source metadata.

nodes.name: Read before comment
nodes.notes: Fetches current issue status/content after inference and before publishing. Helps detect edits, closure or state changes while Gemini was working.

nodes.name: Comments before post
nodes.notes: Reads all discussion again before publication to detect source edits/deletions, new owner instructions or changed refinement history during inference.

nodes.name: Validate before comment
nodes.notes: Rechecks issue, captured source, new owner discussion and prior refinement history after Gemini finishes. A mismatch stops publication and leaves busy held for owner inspection.

nodes.name: Post refinement
nodes.notes: GitHub write: posts the validated, marked Markdown as a new comment; prior revisions remain intact. A lost response is uncertain even if GitHub accepted the comment: never retry blindly.

nodes.name: Check comment receipt
nodes.notes: Requires HTTP 201, a comment ID, the configured owner author and exact rendered body. Failure stops before Ready; the owner must inspect GitHub before deciding whether another POST is safe.

nodes.name: Read before Ready
nodes.notes: Fetches the current issue before the Ready transition. Both newly posted and reused-output paths converge here.

nodes.name: Comments before Ready
nodes.notes: Reads all discussion to verify that exactly one matching, intact refinement is current before leaving Refining.

nodes.name: Validate before Ready
nodes.notes: Requires unchanged source, an open Refining issue and exactly one latest matching output. Checks the comment body against the posted/reused version. Failure holds rather than marking stale content Ready.

nodes.name: Add Ready
nodes.notes: GitHub write: adds Ready for approval after output is verified. This requests owner review; it does not grant Approved. Refining remains until the next acknowledged removal.

nodes.name: Check added Ready
nodes.notes: Requires the label response to contain Ready for approval and Refining as the only managed states. An uncertain add stops before removing Refining.

nodes.name: Remove Ready source
nodes.notes: GitHub write: removes only Refining after Ready for approval was acknowledged. Preserves unrelated labels; never adds Approved.

nodes.name: Check removed Ready
nodes.notes: Requires the removal response to confirm Ready for approval as the only managed state. Failure leaves the guard held for inspection.

nodes.name: Read final issue
nodes.notes: Fetches the final issue after the Ready transition, before declaring successful work.

nodes.name: Read final comments
nodes.notes: Reads discussion one last time to confirm captured input and the matching output still exist before the release path.

nodes.name: Success
nodes.notes: Confirms open owner-authored Ready state, unchanged source and one matching refinement. Produces acknowledged success with source/comment references, budget and generation attempt history (null when reusing output); does not itself release busy.

nodes.name: Question revision
nodes.notes: Route Waiting tasks to the question path; Ideas/Ready keep the established refinement path.

nodes.name: Read question registry
nodes.notes: Authenticated read of unconsumed durable questions. Unknown or ambiguous ledger identity stops.

nodes.name: Read Waiting issue
nodes.notes: Read current author, closure and sole Waiting state before considering a reply.

nodes.name: Read Waiting comments
nodes.notes: Read every comment page; exact question, captured source and owner answer must remain intact.

nodes.name: Plan owner answer
nodes.notes: Require one fresh unedited owner reply with the exact question id and literal scope line. Missing scope is reported with required grammar; competing replies hold. Factory markers cannot answer or grant initial approval.

nodes.name: Have scoped answer
nodes.notes: Only an exact unchanged-scope reply can enter durable authorization. Others wait or route to refinement.

nodes.name: Changed answer scope
nodes.notes: Changed scope returns to Ideas, never Approved. Missing scope stays Waiting and reports required confirmation.

nodes.name: Report unanswered question
nodes.notes: Report waiting or missing-confirmation guidance; the published question already contains exact instructions. Release only this workflow guard.

nodes.name: Persist scoped answer
nodes.notes: Commit unique answer claim through the runner, which independently rereads GitHub/source. No Approved write precedes this acknowledgement.

nodes.name: Verify answer claim
nodes.notes: Require the exact committed question/answer/source lineage, not merely a successful HTTP status.

nodes.name: Recheck answered issue
nodes.notes: Read current issue after the durable claim and immediately before derived approval.

nodes.name: Recheck answered comments
nodes.notes: Recheck exact question/answer, authorship, edits/deletions and source before the label write.

nodes.name: Validate before derived approval
nodes.notes: Compare the full unchanged claim with current GitHub evidence. A changed answer or approved source stops.

nodes.name: Add answered Approved
nodes.notes: Add Approved only for a persisted answer-derived authorization of previously explicitly approved scope. Never grants initial approval.

nodes.name: Check answered Approved
nodes.notes: Require both Waiting and Approved as the only managed labels before removing Waiting.

nodes.name: Remove answered Waiting
nodes.notes: Remove only Waiting after acknowledged derived Approved addition; preserve unrelated labels.

nodes.name: Check answered Waiting removal
nodes.notes: Require sole Approved receipt. Unknown or partial write keeps the fail-stop guard.

nodes.name: Read answered final issue
nodes.notes: Read back open owner-authored sole Approved before reporting the continuation eligible.

nodes.name: Read answered final comments
nodes.notes: Revalidate exact current question/answer and approved source after transition.

nodes.name: Read answered final events
nodes.notes: Read complete Approved-entry history; bind the derived event without confusing it with initial approval.

nodes.name: Verify answered approval
nodes.notes: Assemble the distinct deterministic continuation UUID with original approval, exact answer and retained work. Release only the workflow guard.

nodes.name: Journal changed scope
nodes.notes: Commit the changed-scope label intent against the old question before any external mutation.

nodes.name: Verify changed scope intent
nodes.notes: Require durable intent acknowledgement before routing expanded scope back to refinement.

nodes.name: Recheck changed scope issue
nodes.notes: Observe closure and current Waiting state before changed-scope routing.

nodes.name: Recheck changed scope comments
nodes.notes: Re-read the exact changed-scope owner answer so edits cannot trigger stale routing.

nodes.name: Validate changed scope routing
nodes.notes: Require the same valid question and changed-scope reply immediately before writes.

nodes.name: Add changed scope Ideas
nodes.notes: Add Ideas for renewed refinement; this path never adds Approved.

nodes.name: Check changed scope Ideas
nodes.notes: Require only Waiting and Ideas managed labels before removing the source.

nodes.name: Remove changed scope Waiting
nodes.notes: Remove only Waiting after Ideas acknowledgement, retaining the prior question and partial work.

nodes.name: Check changed scope removal
nodes.notes: Require the removal acknowledgement; unknown effects hold for owner recovery.

nodes.name: Read changed scope final issue
nodes.notes: Read back the changed-scope task before confirming the journal.

nodes.name: Verify changed scope state
nodes.notes: Require an open owner-authored sole Ideas state; renewed specification and explicit owner approval are still required.

nodes.name: Confirm changed scope
nodes.notes: Confirm exact Ideas state in the durable effect journal; never erase historical question/answer evidence.

nodes.name: Complete changed scope
nodes.notes: Release the short guard after confirmed routing. The next refinement captures the changed-scope reply and does not infer approval.

parameters.content:
## US2 — INACTIVE, owner manual import after review
Map EVERY Data Table to the same isolated control table. Map GitHub, Gemini and separate private runner bearer credentials privately; configure the reviewed runner address. No token values in this JSON. Execute whole workflow only with all schedules paused/drained. No stranded-state recovery or write retries. See evidence/refinement-validation.md. Runtime prompt v3 / template v1 embedded by build-refine.cjs. Production activation remains gated.

## 1. Acquire the shared guard

Both triggers enter here. Read the single control row and claim busy before any GitHub write or model request. An existing hold exits unchanged. An invalid row or uncertain acquisition stops processing. The final release is in stage 7.

nodes.name: 2. Find a task and a new revision

parameters.content:
## 2. Find a task and a new revision

Read all pages, inspect owner-authored Ideas/Ready revisions and Waiting questions. Unchanged revisions loop; questions require durable scoped authorization. No eligible work releases the short guard.

## 3. Continue scoped owner answers

Waiting questions use exact ledger-bound markers and one unchanged-scope owner reply. Persist and independently verify the derived authorization before adding Approved. A changed-scope answer returns to Ideas/refinement and renewed explicit owner approval. No reply is initial approval.

## 4. Recheck source and enter Refining

Record the selected issue in the held guard, then reread GitHub before changing state. Add Refining first and remove the old state only after acknowledgement. Partial transitions stop with busy held; they are never repaired automatically.

## 5. Reuse output or ask Gemini

Reuse an exact revision or count the prepared request once. Generation may retry explicit 503/UNAVAILABLE twice, after 10s/30s, under the same held guard. Recheck guard and source before every attempt. Other failures/exhaustion stop for manual recovery. Only validated output proceeds to publication.

## 6. Publish and return to Ready

Check the source after inference before posting. Verify the comment receipt or reused output, then add Ready and remove Refining. This refinement path never grants initial approval; scoped answer continuation uses the separate durable-claim stage. Source changes, uncertain writes or inconsistent evidence retain busy for manual recovery.

## 7. Release only acknowledged work

Successful work and ordinary no-work join here. Check guard ownership, clear busy, verify the update receipt and reread the row. Failures never flow through an unconditional cleanup; an uncertain release requires inspection even if the update may have committed.
